tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per PQ Criteria

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: ASRTU Rate Contract holder OR Original Product Manufacturer with a minimum average annual Turnover of Rs. 7.00 Crores during preceding three continuous years out of four years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 are eligible to participate, duly supported by the audited statement of accounts i.e., Manufacturing / Trading and Profit loss account, balance sheets for all the three years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Upload the documents as per the prequalification criteria.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should submit 5 Mtrs of Expandable Vinyl Coated Fabric sample with clear marking (at only one end of the sample) of the manufacturer (on or before opening of technical bid) conforming to the specification given in the tender for testing, failing which the tender is liable to be disqualified. The sample of Expandable Vinyl Coated Fabric sample will be tested at CIRT, Pune or at any of the NABL accredited Laboratories

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Upload the documents as per the prequalification criteria.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Payment of testing charges: The testing charges at actual are to be borne by the bidders. The testing charge has to be submitted through DD in favour of CAO-FA, BMTC Bengaluru before opening of the tender. The actual cost of testing charges as on date is Rs.36,580/- (under revision). Any changes will be intimated in due course.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Upload the documents as per the prequalification criteria.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderers whose samples are approved in the testing at NABL accredited laboratory & fulfilled the pre-qualification criteria prescribed in the tender will be considered for opening of commercial bid
